body.x: TYLT(www.tylt.com), a leader in portable power and wireless chargers, unveiled Energi Sliding Power Case for iPhone 6/6 Plus, VU Wireless Charging Car Mount, and other several new products at Digital Experience, the press party before the official opening of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Energi Sliding Power Case for iPhone 6/6 Plus provides protection and power in one. The 2­-in-­1 case includes a 3,200mAh rechargeable battery sleeve that will rapidly charge your iPhone 6 at 1.3 amps to more than double its battery life. Once your phone is charged, the battery sleeve can be slid off to use the protective TPU­ lined inner case for enhanced drop protection.

VU Wireless Charging Car Mount is a wireless charger that doubles as a hands­-free car mount to initiate charging. A 2015 CES Innovation Awards Honoree, the VU Wireless Charging Car Mount includes three overlaid charging coils, allowing for easy phone placement to connect and charge, plus an additional USB port to charge a second device. The device’s spring­loaded arms securely grip phones with up to 6" displays, and a 180­degree rotating mount enables phone positioning in horizontal or landscape view.
